items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know how bad he was... this lady says, you think Artie can blow, don't you?

ctx.x: See, I didn't know how bad he was. He may be better now. But I was in Los Angeles and this lady says, you think Artie can blow, don't you? (Inaudible) and he put on a record with a piano player. ________ was trying to play songs.
